exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Qaysi rasmda ko'rsatilgan: baliqchi qayiqlari, restoran, tosh kulba, parom, aeroport, eshak, velosiped, sovg'a do'koni, mehmon uyi, yashil dalalar?
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT 9 — 'Times Change...' (Zamon o'zgaradi...)

MAVZU: joylar va binolar; o'tmish va hozirni qiyoslash.

Bu unitda O'TGAN ZAMON boshlanadi:
  was / were — 'be' ning o'tgan zamoni
  had — 'have' ning o'tgan zamoni
  could — 'can' ning o'tgan zamoni

O'N TA RASM (A dan J gacha) IKKI BETGA YOYILGAN:
  62-betda: A, C, D, F, G, I
  63-betda: B, E, H, J

KITOBDA BERILGAN: fishing boats = A

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a stone cottage = tosh kulba (kichik qishloq uyi)
  a ferry boat = parom (odam va mashina tashiydi)
  a donkey = eshak
  a souvenir shop = sovg'a (esdalik) do'koni
  a guest house = mehmon uyi (kichik mehmonxona)
  green fields = yashil dalalar

⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI — XARITADAGI JOY NOMI:

  62-betdagi xaritada Kilmurvy'dan
  janubi-sharqda 'OURTNAGAPPLE' deb
  yozilgan.

  ⚠ To'g'ri nomi — GORT NA gCAPALL,
  inglizcha yozilishi 'Gortnagapple'.
  Irland tilida 'otlar dalasi' degani.

  ⚠ Kitobda bosh 'G' harfi 'Ou' ga
  aylanib ketgan.

  ⚠ Xaritadagi boshqa nomlar TO'G'RI:
  Bungowla, Onaght, Kilmurvy,
  Brannock Islands.

exercises.instructionEn: Inishmore is a small island off the west coast of Ireland. Look at the pictures again and try to guess what there was/wasn't on Inishmore fifty years ago.
exercises.instructionUz: Inishmore — Irlandiyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i yaqinidagi kichik orol. Rasmlarga yana qarang va ellik yil oldin Inishmoreda nima bor/yo'q bo'lganini taxmin qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU YERDA O'TGAN ZAMON BIRINCHI MARTA ISHLATILADI!

  There IS  → There WAS   (bor edi — birlik)
  There ARE → There WERE  (bor edi — ko'plik)
  There ISN'T → There WASN'T  (yo'q edi — birlik)
  There AREN'T → There WEREN'T (yo'q edi — ko'plik)

QOLIP:
  There WAS a/an + BIRLIK ot.
  There WERE + KO'PLIK ot.
  There WASN'T a/an + BIRLIK ot.
  There WEREN'T any + KO'PLIK ot.

MANTIQ — ELLIK YIL OLDIN NIMA BO'LGAN BO'LISHI MUMKIN:
  ESKI hayotga tegishli: eshak, baliqchi qayiqlari,
     tosh kulba, yashil dalalar
  YANGI hayotga tegishli: aeroport, parom, restoran,
     sovg'a do'koni, mehmon uyi, velosiped

Taxminlar 3 va 4-mashqda tekshiriladi.

tasks.whyUz:
KO'PLIK ot → THERE WERE.
Eshak — eski transport vositasi, o'shanda bo'lgan.

KO'PLIK → THERE WERE.
Baliq ovi — orolning an'anaviy kasbi.

KO'PLIK → THERE WERE.
Tosh kulbalar — orolning eski uylari.

KO'PLIK → THERE WERE.
Dalalar hozir ham bor — ular o'zgarmagan.

BIRLIK va INKOR → THERE WASN'T.
Aeroport — zamonaviy qurilma, ellik yil oldin bo'lmagan.

KO'PLIK va INKOR → THERE WEREN'T ANY.
INKOR gapda ANY ishlatiladi.

KO'PLIK va INKOR → THERE WEREN'T ANY.
Restoran — sayyohlar uchun, o'shanda sayyoh kam edi.

KO'PLIK va INKOR → THERE WEREN'T ANY.
Sovg'a do'koni ham sayyohlar uchun.

KO'PLIK va INKOR → THERE WEREN'T ANY.
Mehmon uyi — sayyohlar uchun turar joy.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the summary about Inishmore, then listen and cross out the wrong word.
exercises.instructionUz: Inishmore haqidagi qisqacha mazmunni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va noto'g'ri so'zni chizib tashlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
QISQACHA MAZMUN (to'g'ri so'zlar bilan):

  Fifty years ago, few tourists could reach Inishmore
  because there wasn't an AIRPORT. Life was DIFFICULT.
  Inishmore was a QUIET place back then. Today there are
  cars, buses and ferry boats. The people have got new,
  modern HOUSES. Inishmore is very BUSY now. There are
  guest houses, restaurants and lots of SOUVENIR shops.
  It is still beautiful, though.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ellik yil oldin kam sayyoh Inishmorega yetib bora olardi,
  chunki AEROPORT yo'q edi. Hayot QIYIN edi. O'shanda
  Inishmore TINCH joy edi. Bugun mashina, avtobus va
  paromlar bor. Odamlarning yangi, zamonaviy UYLARI bor.
  Inishmore hozir juda GAVJUM. Mehmon uylari, restoranlar
  va ko'plab SOVG'A do'konlari bor. Lekin u hali ham go'zal.

QARAMA-QARSHI JUFTLIKLAR:
  port ↔ airport      difficult ↔ easy
  noisy ↔ quiet       houses ↔ cottages
  boring ↔ busy       clothes ↔ souvenir

DIQQAT — 'CROSS OUT THE WRONG WORD':
  NOTO'G'RI so'zni chizib tashlash kerak,
  ya'ni TO'G'RI so'z qoladi.
exercises.audioNoteUz: Kitobda audio bor, lekin barcha javoblarni 63-betdagi maqoladan ham aniq topish mumkin.

tasks.whyUz:
AEROPORT yo'q edi.
63-betdagi maqolada: 'There wasn't an airport or any ferry boats in those days.'
Bandargoh (port) esa bor edi — qayiqlar to'xtagan.

Hayot QIYIN edi.
Maqolada: 'Life was difficult. We didn't have much money.'
Bugun esa: 'Life is very easy now.'

tasks.prompt: 3  Inishmore was a ............ place back then.
tasks.whyUz:
TINCH joy edi.
Maqolada: 'Inishmore was a quiet place.'
Bugun esa: 'Inishmore is very busy now.'
'back then' = o'sha paytda.

tasks.prompt: 4  The people have got new, modern ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
Bugun ular yangi, zamonaviy UYLARGA ega.
Maqolada: 'We have got new, modern houses.'
Ellik yil oldin esa: 'we only had small stone COTTAGES'.

Hozir juda GAVJUM.
Maqolada: 'Inishmore is very busy now.'
3-band bilan solishtiring: ilgari 'quiet', hozir 'busy'.

SOVG'A do'konlari (sayyohlar uchun).
Maqolada: 'lots of souvenir shops'.
E-rasmda ham 'The Souvenir Shop' yozuvi bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: same, water, fields, cottages, houses, little,
         fifty years, shops, boats, like

Barcha iboralar 62–63-betdagi Inishmore matnlaridan olingan.

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  bo'shliq OLDIDA sifat bo'lsa → OT kerak
     fishing ...... → boats
  bo'shliq KEYINIDA ot bo'lsa → SIFAT kerak
     a ...... island → little

tasks.whyUz:
'a little island' = kichik orol.
63-betdagi maqolada: 'a beautiful little island'.
Gap: Inishmore is a little island.

'fifty years ago' = ellik yil oldin.
'ago' — o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi, DOIM gap oxirida.
Gap: Fifty years ago, life was difficult.

'the same AS' = ...bilan bir xil.
Maqolada: 'exactly the same as it was fifty years ago'.
DIQQAT: 'the same LIKE' XATO — 'as' bo'lishi kerak.

'fishing boats' = baliqchi qayiqlari.
Gap: There were only donkeys and fishing boats.

'stone cottages' = tosh kulbalar.
Gap: They only had small stone cottages.

'running water' = vodoprovod suvi.
Gap: They didn't have electricity or running water.

'just like this' = xuddi shundayligicha.
'like' bu yerda PREDLOG — '...kabi' ('yoqtirmoq' EMAS).
Gap: We're working hard to keep it just like this.

'modern houses' = zamonaviy uylar.
5-band bilan solishtiring: ilgari 'stone cottages', hozir 'modern houses'.
Gap: They have got new, modern houses.

'souvenir shops' = sovg'a do'konlari.
Gap: There are lots of souvenir shops now.

'green fields' = yashil dalalar.
Gap: Coneely looks across the green fields in front of his house.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the opposites of the phrases below, using the words in the list. Then, make sentences using the phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi iboralarning qarama-qarshisini ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan yozing. So'ng iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: busy, big, a lot of

'≠' belgisi QARAMA-QARSHI ma'noni bildiradi.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA GAP:
  Inishmore is a little island.

DIQQAT — 'FEW' va 'A LOT OF':
  few tourists = kam sayyoh (deyarli yo'q)
  a lot of tourists = ko'p sayyoh
  'few' — SANALADIGAN otlar bilan.
  Sanalmaydigan bo'lsa: little ↔ a lot of
     little money ≠ a lot of money

tasks.whyUz:
little ↔ BIG (o'lcham).
Gap: Inishmore is a little island, but Ireland is a big island.

few ↔ A LOT OF (miqdor).
Gap: Fifty years ago there were few tourists, but now there are
a lot of tourists.

quiet ↔ BUSY (gavjumlik).
62-betdagi mashqda ham bor edi.
Gap: Inishmore was a quiet place then, but it is a busy place now.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing prepositions from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan tushib qolgan predloglarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: in front of, on, off, back, in, across, at

DIQQAT: 7 ta so'z, 9 ta bo'shliq —
demak ba'zilari IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi:
  'at' → 2 marta (at first, looking at)
  'in' → 2 marta (in fact, in those days)

Hamma iboralar 63-betdagi maqoladan olingan.
Bu — TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR, ular yodlanadi.

tasks.whyUz:
'ON our page' = sahifamizda.
Gazeta va jurnal sahifasi uchun ON ishlatiladi.

'look AT something' = biror narsaga qaramoq.
DIQQAT: 'look' turli predloglar bilan turli ma'no beradi:
  look AT = qaramoq;  look FOR = qidirmoq;
  look AFTER = qaramoq (parvarish).

'AT first' = dastlab, birinchi qarashda.
DIQQAT: 'at first' ↔ 'at last' (nihoyat).

'IN fact' = aslida, haqiqatda.
'at first' bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yiladi.

'IN those days' = o'sha kunlarda.
O'tgan zamon haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

'IN FRONT OF his house' = uyi oldida.
Aksi: 'behind' (orqasida).

'BACK then' = o'sha paytda.
'in those days' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

'look ACROSS' = ...bo'ylab qaramoq (bir chetdan ikkinchisiga).
'across' = bo'ylab, kesib o'tib.

exercises.instructionEn: This is the town map of Greenhill. Use the words from the list below and label the places.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu — Greenhill shahar xaritasi. Quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlardan foydalanib joylarni nomlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (10 ta):
  newsagent's, butcher's, library, baker's, greengrocer's,
  chemist's, post office, restaurant, supermarket, cinema

Har bir binoda RASM bor — shu rasmga qarab nomni topasiz.

DIQQAT — DO'KON NOMLARIDAGI APOSTROF ('s):
  baker      = nonvoy (ODAM)
  baker'S    = nonvoyxona (JOY)
  butcher    = qassob (ODAM)
  butcher'S  = qassobxona (JOY)

Sababi: to'liq shakli "the baker'S SHOP" edi —
'shop' so'zi tushib qolgan, apostrof qolgan.
Shuning uchun bu do'konlar DOIM 's bilan yoziladi.

APOSTROFSIZ JOYLAR:
  library, post office, restaurant, supermarket, cinema
  (bular biror kasb egasining nomi bilan atalmagan)

XARITA TUZILISHI:

     │Oak                      │High
     │Street                   │Street
  ───┼─────────────┬───────────┼──────────────
     │ 1 RESTAURANT│ 2 NEWS-   │ 3 GREENGROCER'S
     │             │   AGENT'S │
     ├─────────────┼───────────┼──────────────
     │ 4 BUTCHER'S │ 5 CHEMIST'S│ 6 CINEMA
     ├─────────────┼───────────┼──────────────
     │ 7 BAKER'S   │ 8 SUPER-  │ 9 LIBRARY
     │             │   MARKET  │
  ═══╪═════ PARK STREET ═══════╪══════════════
     │ 10 POST OFFICE (+ BUS STOP oldida)

⚠ NEGA DO'KON NOMLARIDA APOSTROF BOR?

  butcher'S, baker'S, greengrocer'S,
  chemist'S, newsagent'S

  ⚠ Bu — BRITANIYA an'anasi. To'liq shakli:
     'the butcher's SHOP' = qassobning
     do'koni.
  Keyinchalik 'shop' so'zi tushib qolgan,
  apostrof esa qolgan.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'at the butcher's' deyiladi
  — 'at the butcher shop' EMAS.

  ⚠ Xuddi shu qoida: 'at the doctor's'
  (shifokorda), 'at my aunt's' (xolamnikida).


⚠ BRITANChA / AMERIKAChA:

  chemist's (BrE)  = drugstore / pharmacy (AmE)
  greengrocer's (BrE) — Amerikada bunday
     alohida do'kon deyarli yo'q, hammasi
     supermarketda sotiladi
  cinema (BrE)     = movie theater (AmE)

tasks.whyUz:
Pichoq-vilka rasmi → RESTAURANT (restoran).
Apostrof YO'Q.

Gazeta rasmi → NEWSAGENT'S (gazeta do'koni).
'news' + 'agent' + 's.
Gazeta, jurnal, sigaret, konfet sotiladi.

Meva rasmi → GREENGROCER'S (meva-sabzavot do'koni).
'green' (yashil) + 'grocer' (oziq-ovqat sotuvchisi).

Go'sht rasmi → BUTCHER'S (qassobxona).
'a butcher' = qassob (odam).

Dori rasmi → CHEMIST'S (dorixona).
'a chemist' = dorixonachi.
Amerikacha: drugstore / pharmacy.

Kinoapparat rasmi → CINEMA (kinoteatr).
Apostrof YO'Q.
Amerikacha: movie theater.

Non rasmi → BAKER'S (nonvoyxona).
'a baker' = nonvoy; 'to bake' = pishirmoq.

Aravacha rasmi → SUPERMARKET.
Apostrof YO'Q.
Hamma narsa bir joyda sotiladi.

Kitoblar rasmi → LIBRARY (kutubxona).
DIQQAT: 'library' = kutubxona (kitob QARZGA olinadi),
'a bookshop' = kitob do'koni (kitob SOTIB olinadi).
Bu — juda ko'p adashtiriladigan so'z.

Xat rasmi → POST OFFICE (pochta bo'limi).
Apostrof YO'Q.
Yonida BUS STOP (avtobus bekati) bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the magazine article.
exercises.instructionUz: Jurnal maqolasini o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA — 'NOW & THEN' (Hozir va o'shanda) RUKNI.

TUZILISHI:
  1-xatboshi: orol haqida umumiy ma'lumot
  2-xatboshi: ELLIK YIL OLDIN (o'tgan zamon)
  3-xatboshi: BUGUN (hozirgi zamon)
  4-xatboshi: orol aholisining fikri

BU MAQOLADA IKKI ZAMON QIYOSLANADI:
  O'TMISH: was, were, wasn't, weren't, had, didn't have,
           could, couldn't
  HOZIR:   is, are, have got, can

QALIN SO'ZLAR (4-mashqda tushuntiriladi):
  west coast, seems, in fact, islander, reach,
  getting around, running water, in front of

QAHRAMON: Colman Coneely — 70 yoshli orol aholisi.

tasks.en: This week on our Now & Then page, we are looking at Inishmore, a beautiful little island off the west coast of Ireland.
tasks.uz: Bu hafta 'Hozir va o'shanda' sahifamizda biz Inishmore — Irlandiyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i yaqinidagi go'zal kichik orolni ko'rib chiqamiz.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: the west coast = g'arbiy qirg'oq.
'OFF the coast' = qirg'oq yaqinida (dengizda).
'we are looking at' — Present Continuous (hozirgi son).

tasks.en: At first, Inishmore seems exactly the same as it was fifty years ago, but in fact it is a very different place today.
tasks.uz: Dastlab Inishmore ellik yil oldingidek ko'rinadi, lekin aslida u bugun butunlay boshqa joy.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  seems = ko'rinadi (aslida boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin)
  in fact = aslida, haqiqatda
'At first' = dastlab, birinchi qarashda.

tasks.en: Colman Coneely, a 70-year-old islander, says, "When I was young, few tourists could reach Inishmore."

tasks.en: "Now there is an airport," says Coneely. "There are also cars, buses, bicycles and big ferry boats."

tasks.note: 'There ARE' ↔ 'There WEREN'T any guest houses or restaurants'.

tasks.en: Coneely looks across the green fields in front of his house and smiles.

exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va were(n't), had, was yoki could(n't) ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Some ancient Romans WERE very rich and they HAD beautiful
  brick houses. There WEREN'T any windows on the outside
  walls and there WEREN'T any carpets on the floors. Other
  people HAD smaller houses or flats. Ancient Rome HAD
  narrow streets, but there WERE lots of theatres. The
  public baths WERE very popular. Men and women COULD go
  there at different times, but children COULDN'T use the
  baths. Hunting, riding, fishing and having dinner parties
  with friends WERE also popular free-time activities.
  There WERE lots of games and toys for children. The boys'
  favourite games WERE ball games and the girls HAD dolls
  to play with. Children also HAD dogs, cats, ducks and
  geese as pets. The ancient Romans HAD lots of delicious
  food to eat, such as meat, fish, fruit, vegetables and
  bread, and their favourite drink WAS wine.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ba'zi qadimgi rimliklar juda boy edi va ularning chiroyli
  g'isht uylari bor edi. Tashqi devorlarda deraza yo'q edi
  va polda gilam yo'q edi. Boshqa odamlarning kichikroq
  uylari yoki kvartiralari bor edi. Qadimgi Rimda tor
  ko'chalar bor edi, lekin ko'p teatrlar bor edi. Umumiy
  hammomlar juda mashhur edi. Erkaklar va ayollar u yerga
  turli vaqtlarda bora olardi, lekin bolalar hammomdan
  foydalana olmasdi. Ov qilish, ot minish, baliq ovlash va
  do'stlar bilan ziyofat qilish ham mashhur bo'sh vaqt
  mashg'ulotlari edi. Bolalar uchun ko'p o'yin va o'yinchoq
  bor edi. O'g'il bolalarning sevimli o'yinlari to'p
  o'yinlari edi, qizlarda esa o'ynash uchun qo'g'irchoqlar
  bor edi. Bolalar shuningdek it, mushuk, o'rdak va g'ozni
  uy hayvoni sifatida boqishardi. Qadimgi rimliklarda
  go'sht, baliq, meva, sabzavot va non kabi ko'p mazali
  taomlar bor edi, sevimli ichimliklari esa vino edi.

QAYSI SO'ZNI TANLASH — QOIDA:
  ega + SIFAT/joy      → was / were   (was — birlik)
  ega + NARSA (mulk)   → had
  'There ...' + narsa  → there was / there were
  QOBILIYAT, ruxsat    → could / couldn't

DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKOR BELGISI:
  'There ...... ANY windows' → WEREN'T
  'any' tasdiq gapda deyarli ishlatilmaydi.

'rich' — SIFAT → 'to be' kerak.

'had' hamma ega uchun bir xil.

'There WERE lots of theatres'.

16c-mashqning 2-savoliga javob.
'lots of' = ko'p.

'popular' SIFAT → 'to be'.
'baths' KO'PLIK → WERE.
'public' = umumiy, hammaga ochiq.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A hundred years ago, life WAS very different for the Inuit
  in Canada. In those days, they DIDN'T HAVE houses to live
  in; they HAD igloos — houses made of ice. The Inuit WERE
  hunters of whales and seals. They only HAD meat and fish
  to eat. They COULDN'T eat any fruit or vegetables because
  there WEREN'T any trees or plants. The Inuit HAD Husky
  dogs to help them pull their sledges. They also HAD kayaks
  — small canoes — to help them hunt in the sea. Their
  favourite free-time activities WERE dancing and arts and
  crafts.

  Today, life for the Inuit ISN'T the same as it WAS a
  hundred years ago. They HAVEN'T GOT igloos now. They HAVE
  GOT modern houses and they live in small towns. There ARE
  schools, hospitals, shops and many other modern buildings
  in the towns. These days, the Inuit CAN eat anything they
  like. They HAVEN'T GOT sledges anymore. They travel by
  skidoo — a kind of motorbike on ice. Today, their
  favourite free-time activities are listening to pop music
  and going to the cinema just like most other Canadians.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Yuz yil oldin Kanadadagi inuitlar hayoti juda boshqacha
  edi. O'sha kunlarda ularning yashash uchun uylari yo'q
  edi; iglular — muzdan qurilgan uylar bor edi. Inuitlar
  kit va tyulen ovchilari edi. Ularda faqat go'sht va baliq
  bor edi. Ular meva yoki sabzavot yeya olmasdi, chunki
  daraxt yoki o'simlik yo'q edi. Inuitlarda chana tortishga
  yordam beradigan xaski itlari bor edi. Shuningdek dengizda
  ov qilish uchun kayaklari — kichkina qayiqlari bor edi.
  Sevimli bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari raqs va hunarmandchilik
  edi.
  Bugun inuitlar hayoti yuz yil oldingidek emas. Endi
  ularda iglu yo'q. Zamonaviy uylari bor va kichik
  shaharchalarda yashaydilar. Shaharchalarda maktab,
  kasalxona, do'kon va boshqa ko'p zamonaviy binolar bor.
  Hozirgi kunda inuitlar xohlagan narsasini yeya oladi.
  Endi ularda chana yo'q. Ular skidoo — muz ustidagi
  mototsikl bilan yuradilar. Bugun ularning sevimli bo'sh
  vaqt mashg'ulotlari — pop musiqa tinglash va kinoteatrga
  borish, xuddi boshqa kanadaliklar kabi.

MATN IKKI QISMGA BO'LINGAN:
  1-xatboshi — YUZ YIL OLDIN → hammasi O'TGAN zamonda
  2-xatboshi — BUGUN → hammasi HOZIRGI zamonda

  'Today' so'zi zamonlar chegarasini bildiradi.

QAYSI SO'Z NECHA MARTA:
  had          → 4 marta
  was          → 2 marta
  were         → 2 marta
  haven't got  → 2 marta
  qolganlari   → 1 martadan
  Jami: 17 bo'shliq

sections.title: Was/Were (past simple of the verb "to be")

exercises.instructionEn: Was/Were (past simple of the verb "to be")
exercises.instructionUz: Was/Were ('to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  TASDIQ        SO'ROQ           INKOR
  I was         Was I?           I wasn't
  you were      Were you?        you weren't
  he was        Was he?          he wasn't
  she was       Was she?         she wasn't
  it was        Was it?          it wasn't
  we were       Were we?         we weren't
  you were      Were you?        you weren't
  they were     Were they?       they weren't

KITOBDAGI QOIDALAR:

  • 'to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni — WAS.
    WAS ni BIRINCHI va UCHINCHI shaxs BIRLIKDA
    ishlatamiz (I, he, she, it).
    Qolgan barcha shaxslarda WERE ishlatamiz.

  • SO'ROQni was/were + KISHILIK OLMOSHI bilan yasaymiz.
       Where WERE YOU last night?
       (Kecha kechqurun qayerda eding?)

  • INKORni was/were + not bilan yasaymiz.
       He WASN'T at the party last night.
       (U kecha kechqurun ziyofatda emas edi.)

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Was I/he/she/it ...?
     → Yes, I/he/she/it was.
     → No, I/he/she/it wasn't.
  Were we/you/they ...?
     → Yes, we/you/they were.
     → No, we/you/they weren't.

DIQQAT — 'I' G'ALATI:
  Hozirgi zamonda 'I AM' — alohida shakl.
  O'tgan zamonda 'I WAS' — he/she/it bilan BIR XIL.

DIQQAT — 'YOU' DOIM 'WERE':
  Bitta odamga aytilsa ham WERE:
     You were late, John.  ✓

DIQQAT — 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
  Were you at home?      ✓
  Did you be at home?    ✗ XATO

tasks.en: The past simple of the verb "to be" is was. We use was with the first and the third persons singular. In all other persons we use were.
tasks.uz: 'to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni — was. Was ni 1- va 3-shaxs birlikda ishlatamiz. Qolgan barcha shaxslarda were.

tasks.note:

exercises.instructionEn: Had (past simple of "have")
exercises.instructionUz: Had ('have' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  TASDIQ        SO'ROQ              INKOR
  I had         Did I have?         I didn't have
  you had       Did you have?       you didn't have
  he had        Did he have?        he didn't have
  she had       Did she have?       she didn't have
  it had        Did it have?        it didn't have
  we had        Did we have?        we didn't have
  you had       Did you have?       you didn't have
  they had      Did they have?      they didn't have

KITOBDAGI QOIDALAR:

  • HAD fe'li BARCHA shaxslarda BIR XIL.
  • SO'ROQni DID + EGA + HAVE bilan yasaymiz.
  • INKORni DIDN'T + HAVE bilan yasaymiz.

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Did I/you/he etc have ...?
     → Yes, I/you/he etc did.
     → No, I/you/he etc didn't.

ENG KO'P UCHRAYDIGAN XATO:
  I didn't HAVE a car.     ✓
  I didn't HAD a car.      ✗ XATO
  Did you HAVE a car?      ✓
  Did you HAD a car?       ✗ XATO

  SABABI: 'did/didn't' allaqachon O'TGAN zamonni
  ko'rsatgan. Bir gapda o'tgan zamon IKKI MARTA
  ko'rsatilmaydi — shuning uchun asosiy fe'l
  ASOSIY shaklda ('have') qoladi.

WAS/WERE BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  'to be' → DID KERAK EMAS:  Were you at home?
  'have'  → DID KERAK:       Did you have a car?

  Bu — eng muhim farq. 'to be' o'zi mustaqil,
  'have' esa yordamchi 'did' ga muhtoj.

QISQA JAVOBDA 'HAVE' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
  Did you have a car? — Yes, I DID.  ✓
  Did you have a car? — Yes, I HAD.  ✗ XATO

exercises.instructionEn: Could (past simple of "can")
exercises.instructionUz: Could ('can' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  TASDIQ          SO'ROQ            INKOR
  I could         Could I?          I couldn't
  you could       Could you?        you couldn't
  he could        Could he?         he couldn't
  she could       Could she?        she couldn't
  it could        Could it?         it couldn't
  we could        Could we?         we couldn't
  you could       Could you?        you couldn't
  they could      Could they?       they couldn't

KITOBDAGI QOIDALAR:

  • COULD fe'li BARCHA shaxslarda BIR XIL.
  • SO'ROQni COULD + EGA bilan yasaymiz.
  • INKORni COULD + NOT bilan yasaymiz.

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Could I/you/he etc ...?
     → Yes, I/you/he etc could.
     → No, I/you/he etc couldn't.

DIQQAT — 'HAD' BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  'had'   so'roqda DID kerak:  Did you have ...?
  'could' so'roqda DID KERAK EMAS:  Could you ...?

  Sababi: 'could' — MODAL fe'l ('can', 'must', 'will' kabi).
  Modal fe'llar o'zi so'roq va inkor yasaydi,
  yordamchi 'do/did' ga muhtoj emas.

DIQQAT — KEYINGI FE'L SHAKLI:
  I could SWIM.        ✓  (asosiy shakl)
  I could TO swim.     ✗ XATO ('to' YO'Q)
  I could SWAM.        ✗ XATO (o'tgan shakl YO'Q)
  I could SWIMMING.    ✗ XATO (-ing YO'Q)

MA'NOSI:
  could = o'tgan zamondagi QOBILIYAT yoki RUXSAT
  I could swim when I was five.
     (Besh yoshimda suza olardim.)
  Children couldn't use the public baths.
     (Bolalar umumiy hammomdan foydalana olmasdi.)

sections.titleUz: Grammatika — Was/Were ('to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang.
exercises.explanationUz:
WAS / WERE — 'to be' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ (Affirmative)      INKOR (Negative)
  I/he/she/it   WAS         I/he/she/it   WASN'T
  you/we/they   WERE        you/we/they   WEREN'T

  SO'ROQ (Interrogative)    QISQA JAVOB (Short answers)
  WAS I/he/she/it ...?      Yes, I/he/she/it WAS.
                            No, I/he/she/it WASN'T.
  WERE you/we/they ...?     Yes, you/we/they WERE.
                            No, you/we/they WEREN'T.

ESLATMA — HOZIRGI ZAMON BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  am  →  was        I am tired.   →  I was tired.
  is  →  was        He is happy.  →  He was happy.
  are →  were       We are late.  →  We were late.

MUHIM — 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
  'to be' fe'li so'roq va inkorda DID olmaydi.
     Were you at home?     ✓
     Did you be at home?   ✗ XATO

QISQARTMALAR:
  was not  → wasn't
  were not → weren't

THERE WAS / THERE WERE:
  birlik  → There WAS a cinema.
  ko'plik → There WERE two shops.
  inkor   → There wasn't / There weren't
  so'roq  → Was there ...? / Were there ...?

exercises.explanationUz:
HAD — 'have' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ         I/you/he, etc  HAD
  INKOR          I/you/he, etc  DIDN'T HAVE
  SO'ROQ         DID  I/you/he, etc  HAVE?
  QISQA JAVOB    Yes, I/you/he, etc DID.
                 No,  I/you/he, etc DIDN'T.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL:
  I had, you had, he had, she had, it had,
  we had, they had — HAMMASI 'HAD'.
  Hech qanday -s yoki boshqa shakl YO'Q.
  (Hozirgi zamonda: I have, he HAS — farq bor edi.)

DIQQAT — INKOR VA SO'ROQDA 'HAVE' QAYTADI:
  I didn't HAVE a car.    ✓
  I didn't HAD a car.     ✗ XATO
  Did you HAVE a car?     ✓
  Did you HAD a car?      ✗ XATO
  Sabab: 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan,
  ikkinchi fe'l ASOSIY shaklda qoladi.

WAS/WERE bilan SOLISHTIRING:
  'to be' → did KERAK EMAS:  Were you at home?
  'have' → did KERAK:        Did you have a car?

exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. 100 yil oldin odamlarda BOR bo'lgan narsalarga ✓, YO'Q bo'lganlariga ✗ qo'ying. So'ng juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir rasm ostida IXTIRO QILINGAN YILI yozilgan.
Qoida juda oddiy:
  yil 1900 dan OLDIN  → ✓ (100 yil oldin bor edi)
  yil 1900 dan KEYIN  → ✗ (hali ixtiro qilinmagan edi)

SAKKIZ NARSA (yillari bilan):
  hot-air balloons  1783  →  ✓
  typewriters       1867  →  ✓
  telephones        1876  →  ✓
  cars              1886  →  ✓
  ───────── 1900 ─────────
  TVs               1926  →  ✗
  helicopters       1939  →  ✗
  computers         1939  →  ✗
  compact discs     1979  →  ✗

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Did they have helicopters?
  SB: No, they didn't. Did they have ...

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a hot-air balloon = havo shari
  a typewriter      = yozuv mashinkasi
  a compact disc (CD) = kompakt disk
  a helicopter      = vertolyot

⚠⚠ DIQQAT — '100 YIL OLDIN' QAYSI YILDAN?

  Mashqda '100 years ago' deyilgan va
  chegara 1900-yil qilib olingan.

  ⚠ Sababi: bu kitob taxminan 2002-yilda
  chop etilgan. O'shanda '100 yil oldin'
  = ~1900-yil edi.

  ⚠ Agar BUGUNDAN hisoblasangiz, '100 yil
  oldin' boshqa yil chiqadi va TELEVIZOR
  (1926) javobi O'ZGARIB KETADI.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun bu mashqda chegara
  1900-yil deb OLINADI — kitob shunday
  mo'ljallagan.

  ⚠ Bu xato emas: eski kitoblarda 'now',
  'today', 'X years ago' kabi so'zlar
  KITOB YOZILGAN vaqtga nisbatan
  tushuniladi.


⚠ IXTIRO SANALARI TEKShIRILDI — HAMMASI
TO'G'RI:
  1783 — aka-uka Monbolyelarning havo
     shari (birinchi odamli parvoz)
  1867 — Sholzning yozuv mashinkasi
  1876 — Bellning telefoni (patent)
  1886 — Bensning birinchi avtomobili
  1926 — Berdning televizor namoyishi
  1939 — Sikorskiyning vertolyoti
  1939 — birinchi elektron kompyuterlar
  1979 — Philips va Sony kompakt diski

Havo shari — eng qadimgi uchish vositasi.

DIQQAT: mashina BOR edi, lekin Inishmore orolida
YO'Q edi (62-63-bet) — dunyoda bor, orolda yo'q.

Ro'yxatdagi ENG YANGI ixtiro.

exercises.explanationUz:
COULD — 'can' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  COULD swim.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  COULDN'T swim.
  SO'ROQ       COULD I/you/he, etc  swim?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc COULD.
               No,  I/you/he, etc COULDN'T.

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — COULD.
     I could, he could, they could — -S YO'Q.

  2) KEYINGI FE'L ASOSIY SHAKLDA, 'to' SIZ:
        I could swim.       ✓
        I could to swim.    ✗ XATO
        I could swam.       ✗ XATO

  3) 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
        Could you swim?     ✓
        Did you could swim? ✗ XATO

QISQARTMA:
  could not → couldn't

MA'NOSI:
  could = qo'lidan kelardi, bila olardi (O'TGAN QOBILIYAT)

  B: No, I WASN'T. I WAS at the football match.
  A: Who WERE you with?
  B: I WAS with John.
  A: How WAS the match?
  B: It WAS very exciting! My favourite team won!
     Where WERE you?
  A: I WAS at my parents' house.
  B: WERE you with your sister?
  A: No, I WASN'T. She WAS at work.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Kecha kechqurun kinoteatrda midingiz?
  B: Yo'q, emasdim. Futbol o'yinida edim.
  A: Kim bilan eding?
  B: Jon bilan edim.
  A: O'yin qanday edi?
  B: Juda qiziqarli edi! Sevimli jamoam yutdi!

  A: Ota-onamning uyida edim.
  B: Singling bilan midingiz?
  A: Yo'q, emasdim. U ishda edi.

  Faqat were, was, wasn't berilgan.

QOIDA:
  I, he, she, it → was / wasn't
  you, we, they  → were

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  exciting = qiziqarli, hayajonli
  a team   = jamoa
  to win (won) = yutmoq (yutdi)

BU MASHQ BUTUN UNITNI TEKSHIRADI.

TANLASH UCHUN UCH SAVOL:

  1) ZAMON qaysi?

       ko'plik → were / weren't

  3) 'DID/DIDN'T' dan keyin qaysi shakl?
       DOIM asosiy shakl: HAVE (had EMAS)

ENG KO'P UCHRAYDIGAN UCH XATO:
  didn't HAD    ✗  →  didn't HAVE   ✓

  There WEREN'T a cinema  ✗  →  There WASN'T a cinema  ✓

Gapda O'TGAN zamon belgisi YO'Q ('when I was ...' yo'q) →
HOZIRGI qobiliyat so'ralmoqda → CAN.
'a motorbike' = mototsikl.

tasks.prompt: 2  We didn't had / have a TV when I was little.
tasks.whyUz:
'didn't' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan →
keyingi fe'l ASOSIY shaklda: HAVE.
'didn't had' — eng ko'p uchraydigan XATO.
'little' bu yerda = kichkina, yosh.

tasks.prompt: 3  "Was / Were your brother a quiet child?"  [1-tanlov]

'he weren't' — XATO.

tasks.prompt: 4  There are / were telephones 100 years ago.

tasks.prompt: 5  I had / have a bike when I was five, ...  [1-tanlov]

tasks.prompt: 7  Jill couldn't / can't drive when she was ten years old.

'thirty years ago' → o'tgan zamon.

tasks.prompt: 9  I didn't had / have a computer last year.  [1-tanlov]
tasks.whyUz:
'didn't' + ASOSIY shakl → HAVE.
2-band bilan bir xil qoida.

'last year' → O'TGAN zamon, va 'did' YO'Q →
fe'lning o'zi o'tgan shaklda: HAD.
9-bandning ikki qismini solishtiring:
  didn't HAVE (did bor) ↔ HAD (did yo'q).
'a typewriter' = yozuv mashinkasi.

tasks.whyUz:

tasks.prompt: 11  They wasn't / weren't at the party last night.
tasks.whyUz: 'They' KO'PLIK → WEREN'T.

tasks.whyUz:
'a cinema' BIRLIK → WASN'T.
8-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda 'many shops' ko'plik edi.

tasks.whyUz:
'last year' → O'TGAN zamon.
'did' YO'Q → fe'lning o'zi o'tgan shaklda: HAD.

Oddiy so'roq gap → CAN.
'the violin' — cholg'u asbobi oldidan THE.

exercises.instructionUz: am/'m (not), is, are, aren't, was, were, wasn't, weren't, can, could, had yoki didn't have ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N IKKI SHAKL — TO'RT GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  HOZIRGI 'to be':   am / 'm not, is, are, aren't
  O'TGAN 'to be':    was, were, wasn't, weren't
  QOBILIYAT:         can (hozir), could (o'tgan)
  MULK (o'tgan):     had, didn't have

TANLASH TARTIBI:

  1) Keyin FE'L keladimi?
        HA  → can / could
        YO'Q → 'to be' yoki 'had'

  2) Zamon qaysi?
        now, today → hozirgi
        ... ago, when I was ..., then → o'tgan

  3) Ega birlikmi, ko'plikmi?

DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Are you ...?    → No, I'm not.
  Was there ...?  → No, there wasn't.
  Could you ...?  → No, I couldn't.

tasks.whyUz:
Yosh so'ralmoqda, vaqt belgisi yo'q → HOZIRGI zamon.
'you' → ARE.
So'roq gapda boshda.

'Are you ...?' savoliga → 'No, I'M NOT.'
'I am not' ning qisqa shakli.
DIQQAT: 'I amn't' shakli YO'Q.

'I' → AM ('I'm twelve' ham to'g'ri).
Yosh aytishda 'to be' ishlatiladi.

tasks.speak: 3  A: ............ there an airport here twenty years ago?

tasks.whyUz: Savol 'Was there ...?' → javob 'No, there WASN'T.'

'now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
'one' bu yerda 'an airport' o'rniga turibdi — BIRLIK → IS.
'There is one now' = hozir bittasi bor.

tasks.speak: 4  There ............ green fields here when I was little, ...

tasks.whyUz:

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  He CAN talk when he was two.  →  COULD
  ('can' o'chirilib, chetiga 'could' yozilgan)

Har bir gapda BITTA xato bor — DOIM ZAMON xatosi
yoki fe'l shakli xatosi.

UCH XIL XATO BU MASHQDA:

  1) ZAMON MOS EMAS
     Gap ichida o'tgan zamon belgisi bor, lekin fe'l
     hozirgi zamonda (yoki teskarisi).
        He CAN talk when he WAS two.   → could
        Bobby could play basketball NOW. → can

  2) 'DID/DIDN'T' DAN KEYIN NOTO'G'RI SHAKL
        Did you HAD a TV?     → have
        They didn't HAD CDs.  → have

  3) EGA BILAN MOS EMAS
        I ARE good friends.   → was

USUL: avval gapdagi VAQT so'zini toping
(when he was five, now, at the moment, fifty years ago,
last night, then), so'ng fe'l unga mos keladimi — tekshiring.

tasks.speak: 2  Steve couldn't drive a car when he is five.  →  ?

To'g'ri gap: My dad IS at work at the moment.
tasks.speak: 4  My dad was at work at the moment.  →  ?

tasks.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
'could' emas, CAN.
To'g'ri gap: Bobby CAN play basketball now.

tasks.whyUz:

tasks.speak: 6  They didn't had CDs fifty years ago.  →  ?

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu mashq 1-9 unitlarning HAMMASINI tekshiradi:
joy predloglari, was/were, artikllar, some/any,
egalik olmoshlari, harakat predloglari, much/many,
qisqa javoblar, idish nomlari, muloyim savol.

tasks.prompt: 1  A: I can't find my shoe!  B: It's ............ the sofa.
tasks.whyUz:
MANTIQ: yo'qolgan tufli odatda divan OSTIDA bo'ladi → UNDER.
'between' ikkita narsa kerak (bitta divan bor).
'above' = tepasida, havoda — mantiqsiz.

tasks.prompt: 2  When I ............ five, I could read.
tasks.whyUz:
'I' → WAS ('were' EMAS).
'could read' o'tgan zamonni tasdiqlaydi → 'am' ham noto'g'ri.

Kasb aytishda artikl SHART: 'She is A teacher'.
'Maths' /mæθs/ — 'm' UNDOSH tovush → A ('an' EMAS).
'a Maths teacher' = matematika o'qituvchisi.

tasks.prompt: 4  There aren't ............ chairs in the kitchen.
tasks.whyUz:
'aren't' — INKOR gap → ANY.
'some' tasdiq gapda ishlatiladi.
'a' + ko'plik ot ('chairs') mumkin emas.

tasks.prompt: 5  A: Is this John's coat?  B: Yes, it's ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
Savolda 'JOHN'S coat' — Jon ERKAK → HIS.
'mine' = meniki;  'yours' = seniki.
'his' — egalik olmoshi, ot kerak emas.

tasks.prompt: 6  We always go ............ bed before 12 o'clock.
tasks.whyUz:
'go TO bed' = yotmoq — o'zgarmas ibora.
DIQQAT: 'bed' oldidan artikl YO'Q ('go to THE bed' XATO).
Shunga o'xshash: go to school, go to work.

tasks.prompt: 7  ............ sugar do you want in your coffee?
tasks.whyUz:
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → HOW MUCH.
'How many' sanaladigan otlar bilan (How many cups?).
'How long' — davomiylik yoki uzunlik uchun.

tasks.prompt: 8  A: Are they watching television?  B: No, they ............ . They're having dinner.
tasks.whyUz:
Savol 'ARE they ...?' bilan boshlangan →
qisqa javobda ham 'are' → 'No, they AREN'T.'
Qisqa javobda SAVOLDAGI yordamchi fe'l takrorlanadi.

tasks.prompt: 9  I'm not very hungry. I just want a ............ of soup for lunch.
tasks.whyUz:
'a BOWL of soup' = bir kosa sho'rva — o'zgarmas birikma.
'a cup of' — choy/kofe uchun.
'a plate of' — quyuq taom uchun (plov, makaron).

'CAN I help you?' = Yordam bera olamanmi? —
do'kon, mehmonxona, idorada xodimning standart iborasi.
'Do I help you?' — mantiqsiz.
'Would I help you?' — noto'g'ri qolip
('WOULD YOU like ...?' bo'lardi).

exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglab takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TOVUSH:

  /s/ — sof 's' tovushi.
        Til tishga yaqin, havo tor yo'ldan chiqadi.
        O'zbekchadagi 'S' ga o'xshaydi: SUV, SOAT.

  /ʃ/ — 'sh' tovushi.
        Lablar biroz oldinga cho'ziladi.
        O'zbekchadagi 'SH' ga o'xshaydi: SHAHAR, SHIRIN.

YOZILISHI BO'YICHA QOIDA:
  SH ...... → deyarli DOIM /ʃ/     shop, ship, shoe
  S ......  → odatda /s/           sun, sport, street

OLTI SO'Z:
  shop    /ʃɒp/     → /ʃ/
  sport   /spɔːt/   → /s/
  shoe    /ʃuː/     → /ʃ/
  ship    /ʃɪp/     → /ʃ/
  sun     /sʌn/     → /s/
  street  /striːt/  → /s/

DIQQAT — ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK:
  ship /ʃɪp/  ↔  sip /sɪp/  (ho'plamoq)
  shop /ʃɒp/  ↔  stop /stɒp/
  Bitta tovush ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi.

DIQQAT — 'shoe' YOZILISHI ALDAYDI:
  'shoe' — /ʃuː/ deb o'qiladi ('shu').

exercises.instructionEn: Ralph Cobbler is talking about Canary Wharf, an area in London. Listen to what he says and complete the reporter's notes below. Finally, use the notes to talk about what Canary Wharf was like twenty years ago and what it is like today.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL (to'ldirilgan holda):

  ┌── THEN (20 yil oldin) ──────┬── NOW (hozir) ──────────────┐
  │ Canary Wharf was a DIRTY    │ Canary Wharf is a CLEAN     │
  │ area twenty years ago.      │ area nowadays.              │
  │                             │                             │
  │ There were EMPTY            │ There are BEAUTIFUL flats,  │
  │ warehouses.                 │ lots of shops, offices,     │
  │                             │ restaurants and cafés.      │
  │ There weren't MANY shops    │                             │
  │ or people.                  │ People have got a lot of    │
  │                             │ money, LOVELY houses and    │
  │ People didn't have MUCH     │ NEW cars.                   │
  │ money or NICE houses        │                             │
  │ or cars.                    │ People can get around by    │
  │                             │ train, bus or taxi.         │
  │ People could only get       │                             │
  │ around by bus or on foot.   │                             │
  └─────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────┘

O'ZBEKCHA:
  ILGARI: Canary Wharf iflos hudud edi. Bo'sh omborlar bor edi.
  Ko'p do'kon yoki odam yo'q edi. Odamlarda ko'p pul, chiroyli
  uy yoki mashina yo'q edi. Faqat avtobusda yoki piyoda yura
  olardilar.
  HOZIR: Canary Wharf toza hudud. Go'zal kvartiralar, ko'p
  do'kon, ofis, restoran va kafelar bor. Odamlarda ko'p pul,
  chiroyli uylar va yangi mashinalar bor. Poyezd, avtobus yoki
  taksida yura oladilar.

JAVOBLAR QANDAY ANIQLANDI:
  Kitob har bir bo'shliqning BIRINCHI HARFINI bergan,
  jadval esa THEN ↔ NOW qarama-qarshiligi ustiga qurilgan.
  Shuning uchun javoblar aniq:
     d... ↔ c...   → DIRTY ↔ CLEAN (iflos ↔ toza)
     e...          → EMPTY warehouses (bo'sh omborlar)
     m... shops    → MANY (inkor 'weren't' bilan)
     m... money    → MUCH (sanalmaydigan 'money' bilan)
     n... houses   → NICE
     b... flats    → BEAUTIFUL
     l... houses   → LOVELY
     n... cars     → NEW

MUCH va MANY FARQI:
  MANY — sanaladigan ko'plik: many shops, many people
  MUCH — sanalmaydigan:       much money, much water
  Ikkalasi ham asosan INKOR va SO'ROQda ishlatiladi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a warehouse = ombor
  an area     = hudud
  nowadays    = hozirgi kunda
  to get around = yurmoq, borib kelmoq
  on foot     = piyoda
  an office   = ofis, idora

11b-matndagi Inuitlar haqidagi matnni NAMUNA qilib oling —
u ham aynan shu tuzilishda yozilgan.

TO'LIQ NAMUNA MATN:

  In Ancient Greece, people had small houses with small
  windows and two or three rooms. They had meat, fish,
  fruit, vegetables and olives to eat. They travelled by
  horse and they had ships to sail the seas. Their favourite
  free-time activities were hunting and horseback riding.

  Today, life in Greece is very different. People have got
  blocks of flats and villas, and there are glass office
  blocks in the cities. They can eat anything they like.
  They travel by car, ship, train or aeroplane. Their
  favourite free-time activities are dancing, going to the
  cinema or the theatre and watching TV.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Qadimgi Gretsiyada odamlarning kichik derazali, ikki-uch
  xonali kichik uylari bor edi. Yeyish uchun go'sht, baliq,
  meva, sabzavot va zaytun bor edi. Ular ot bilan yurishardi
  va dengizlarda suzish uchun kemalari bor edi. Sevimli
  bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari ov qilish va ot minish edi.
  Bugun Gretsiyadagi hayot juda boshqacha. Odamlarning
  ko'p qavatli uylari va villalari bor, shaharlarda shisha
  ofis binolari bor. Ular xohlagan narsasini yeya oladilar.
  Mashina, kema, poyezd yoki samolyotda yuradilar. Sevimli
  bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari — raqs, kinoteatr yoki teatrga
  borish va televizor ko'rish.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an olive        = zaytun
  a block of flats = ko'p qavatli turar joy binosi
  a villa         = villa, hovli-uy
  an office block = ofis binosi
  to sail         = suzmoq (kema bilan)
  horseback riding = ot minish
  an aeroplane    = samolyot (amerikacha: airplane)

sentencePatterns.formula: There WAS a/an + birlik ot.  /  There WERE + ko'plik ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There was a port. There were donkeys and fishing boats.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bandargoh bor edi. Eshaklar va baliqchi qayiqlari bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'there is' → 'there WAS';  'there are' → 'there WERE'.

sentencePatterns.formula: There WASN'T a/an + birlik.  /  There WEREN'T ANY + ko'plik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There wasn't an airport. There weren't any guest houses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Aeroport yo'q edi. Mehmon uylari yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: INKOR gapda ANY ishlatiladi (hozirgi zamondagi kabi).

sentencePatterns.formula: Life WAS + sifat.  /  X WAS a + sifat + place.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Life was difficult. Inishmore was a quiet place.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hayot qiyin edi. Inishmore tinch joy edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni: is → WAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: Few tourists COULD + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Few tourists could reach Inishmore.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kam sayyoh Inishmorega yetib bora olardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'can' ning o'tgan zamoni — COULD.
'few' = kam (deyarli yo'q — salbiy ma'no).

sentencePatterns.formula: X is a small island OFF the + tomon + coast OF + mamlakat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Inishmore is a small island off the west coast of Ireland.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Inishmore — Irlandiyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i yaqinidagi kichik orol.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'OFF the coast' = qirg'oq yaqinida (dengizda).
'the west coast OF Ireland' — 'of' bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is still + sifat, THOUGH.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is still beautiful, though.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Lekin u hali ham go'zal.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'still' = hali ham;  'though' = lekin (gap OXIRIDA).

sentencePatterns.formula: There WAS/WERE ...  ↔  There IS/ARE ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There were only donkeys then. Now there are cars and buses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'shanda faqat eshaklar bor edi. Hozir mashinalar va avtobuslar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'tmish va hozirni qiyoslashning asosiy qolipi.

sentencePatterns.formula: They HAD ...  ↔  They HAVE GOT ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We only had small stone cottages. We have got new, modern houses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bizda faqat kichik tosh kulbalar bor edi. Bizda yangi, zamonaviy uylar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' ning o'tgan zamoni — HAD ('had got' odatda ishlatilmaydi).

sentencePatterns.formula: They DIDN'T HAVE + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We didn't have much money. We didn't even have electricity.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bizda ko'p pul yo'q edi. Bizda hatto elektr ham yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
O'tgan zamon inkori: DIDN'T + fe'l ASOS shaklida.
'didn't HAD' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: COULD + fe'l  (can ning o'tgan zamoni).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Few tourists could reach Inishmore.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kam sayyoh Inishmorega yetib bora olardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'could' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida ('to' va '-s' YO'Q).

sentencePatterns.formula: X SEEMS ... , but IN FACT ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Inishmore seems exactly the same, but in fact it is a very different place.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Inishmore xuddi o'shanday ko'rinadi, lekin aslida u butunlay boshqa joy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'seem' — tashqi ko'rinish;  'in fact' — haqiqat.
Bu ikkisi doim qarama-qarshi qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: up to + son + ot + A DAY.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Up to 2,000 tourists a day can visit Inishmore.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kuniga 2000 tagacha sayyoh Inishmorega tashrif buyurishi mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'up to' = eng ko'pi bilan.
'a day' = kuniga ('a' = har).

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is NEXT TO / OPPOSITE the Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The police station is next to the cinema. The school is opposite the cinema.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Militsiya bo'limi kinoteatr yonida. Maktab kinoteatr ro'parasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'cha ajratmasa — NEXT TO;  ajratsa — OPPOSITE.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is BETWEEN the Y AND the Z.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The café is between the bank and the post office.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kafe bank va pochta orasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'between ... AND ...' — 'and' HECH QACHON tushmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is ON THE CORNER OF ... Street AND ... Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The park is on the corner of Apple Street and King Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bog' Apple Street va King Street burchagida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'zgarmas ibora: 'on the corner OF'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Excuse me, can you tell me the way TO the ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the bank?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz, bankka qanday borishni aytib bera olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Notanish odamdan yo'l so'rashning eng muloyim shakli.
'the way TO' — 'to' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: Go straight down + ko'cha, then take the first turning ON YOUR left/right.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Go straight down Hill Street, then take the first turning on your left.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hill Street bo'ylab to'g'ri yuring, so'ng birinchi burilishdan chapga buriling.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Yo'l ko'rsatish — BUYRUQ gaplar bilan (ega yo'q).

sentencePatterns.formula: X ≠ Y  (qarama-qarshi iboralar).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a little island ≠ a big island;  few tourists ≠ a lot of tourists
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: kichik orol ≠ katta orol;  kam sayyoh ≠ ko'p sayyoh
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SANALADIGAN: few ↔ a lot of
SANALMAYDIGAN: little ↔ a lot of

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS / WERE + ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I was at home. They were at school.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men uyda edim. Ular maktabda edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: I/he/she/it → WAS;  you/we/they → WERE.

sentencePatterns.formula: WAS / WERE + ega + ...?  → Yes, ... was/were. / No, ... wasn't/weren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Were you at home last night? — No, I wasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun uydamiding? — Yo'q, emasdim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'to be' so'roqda DID OLMAYDI — fe'lning o'zi oldinga chiqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: WAS there a/an + birlik?  /  WERE there any + ko'plik?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Was there an airport? Were there any bicycles?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Aeroport bormidi? Velosipedlar bormidi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ot BIRLIK bo'lsa WAS, KO'PLIK bo'lsa WERE.
Ko'plikda 'any' qo'shiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + HAD + ... .   (hamma ega uchun bir xil)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They had typewriters. She had a cat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda yozuv mashinkasi bor edi. Unda mushuk bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: HAD — hech qachon o'zgarmaydi, -s olmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + DIDN'T HAVE + ... .   /   DID + ega + HAVE + ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They didn't have computers. Did they have helicopters?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda kompyuter yo'q edi. Ularda vertolyot bormidi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'did/didn't' dan keyin HAVE (had EMAS) — bu eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

sentencePatterns.formula: They had X 100 years ago, BUT they didn't have Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They had hot-air balloons 100 years ago, but they didn't have helicopters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 100 yil oldin havo sharlari bor edi, lekin vertolyotlar yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' — qarama-qarshilikni bog'laydi, oldidan VERGUL.

sentencePatterns.formula: What was + ega + LIKE?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What was your best friend like? — He was funny and kind.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eng yaqin do'sting qanday edi? — U qiziqarli va mehribon edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: XARAKTER so'raladi. Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + COULD / COULDN'T + asosiy fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Men and women could go there. Children couldn't use the baths.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Erkaklar va ayollar bora olardi. Bolalar hammomdan foydalana olmasdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'could' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' siz va -ed siz.

sentencePatterns.formula: X could ... WHEN he was [yosh], but Y couldn't ... UNTIL he was [yosh].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paul could talk when he was one, but Doug couldn't talk until he was two.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pol bir yoshida gapira olardi, lekin Dag ikki yoshigacha gapira olmasdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: TASDIQ → when;  INKOR → until.

sentencePatterns.formula: There WEREN'T ANY + ko'plik ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There weren't any windows on the outside walls.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tashqi devorlarda deraza yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'any' inkor va so'roq gaplarda ishlatiladi, tasdiqda emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + HAD + narsa.   ↔   There WAS/WERE + narsa.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They had dolls. There were lots of toys.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda qo'g'irchoq bor edi. Ko'p o'yinchoq bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HAD — kimdadir bor edi (EGA bor).
THERE WAS/WERE — umuman mavjud edi (ega yo'q).

sentencePatterns.formula: ..., such as A, B, C and D.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: lots of delicious food, such as meat, fish, fruit, vegetables and bread
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: go'sht, baliq, meva, sabzavot va non kabi ko'p mazali taomlar
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'such as' = ...kabi, masalan — misol keltiradi.
Oxirgi ikki so'z 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: -ing shakli + WERE + popular activities.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hunting, riding and fishing were popular free-time activities.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ov qilish, ot minish va baliq ovlash mashhur mashg'ulotlar edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Mashg'ulot nomlari -ing bilan yasaladi va OT vazifasini bajaradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOZIR: There is/are ... .   ILGARI: There was/were ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a bank opposite the cinema, but fifty years ago there wasn't a bank.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kinoteatr ro'parasida bank bor, lekin ellik yil oldin bank yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'now' → is/are;  'fifty years ago', 'then' → was/were.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOZIR: have/has got ... .   ILGARI: had ... / didn't have ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Now he has got three dogs, but he hasn't got any cats. When he was five, he had a cat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hozir uning uchta iti bor, lekin mushugi yo'q. Besh yoshida mushugi bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' ning o'tgan shakli — HAD (has got ham HAD).

sentencePatterns.formula: HOZIR: can + fe'l.   ILGARI: could + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When I was five, I could ride a bicycle, but I couldn't ride a motor bike. Now I can ride it very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Besh yoshimda velosiped hayday olardim, lekin mototsikl hayday olmasdim. Hozir uni juda yaxshi haydayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can/could' dan KEYIN doim FE'L keladi; 'have got' dan keyin OT.

sentencePatterns.formula: There weren't MANY + sanaladigan.   People didn't have MUCH + sanalmaydigan.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There weren't many shops or people. People didn't have much money.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'p do'kon yoki odam yo'q edi. Odamlarda ko'p pul yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: MANY — sanaladigan ko'plik;  MUCH — sanalmaydigan.

sentencePatterns.formula: People could ONLY get around BY bus or ON foot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: People could only get around by bus or on foot.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odamlar faqat avtobusda yoki piyoda yura olardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'only' cheklovni bildiradi.
Transport — BY, lekin PIYODA — ON foot.

sentencePatterns.formula: This area is now completely different to what it was like twenty years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This area is now completely different to what it was like twenty years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu hudud yigirma yil oldingidan butunlay boshqacha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'then-and-now' maqolasining tayyor kirish qolipi.
'different to' (britancha) = 'different from'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS/WERE + ... .   /   WAS/WERE + ega + ...?   /   Ega + WASN'T/WEREN'T + ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He was at home. Where were you last night? He wasn't at the party last night.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uyda edi. Kecha kechqurun qayerda eding? U kecha ziyofatda emas edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
I/he/she/it → was;  you/we/they → were.
'did' hech qachon kerak emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + HAD + ot.   /   DID + ega + HAVE + ot?   /   Ega + DIDN'T HAVE + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They had a car. Did they have a car? They didn't have a car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda mashina bor edi. Ularda mashina bormidi? Ularda mashina yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: So'roq va inkorda 'did' KERAK, keyin 'have' (had EMAS).

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + COULD + asosiy fe'l.   /   COULD + ega + asosiy fe'l?   /   Ega + COULDN'T + asosiy fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She could swim. Could she swim? She couldn't swim.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U suza olardi. U suza olarmidi? U suza olmasdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'could' modal fe'l — 'did' kerak emas.
Keyingi fe'l 'to' siz, asosiy shaklda.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is BETWEEN the Y AND the Z.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The mouse is between the two cheeses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sichqon ikki pishloq orasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'between' DOIM 'and' bilan juft.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is IN FRONT OF / BEHIND / NEXT TO / OPPOSITE the Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The mouse is in front of the cheese. The mouse is behind the cheese.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sichqon pishloq oldida. Sichqon pishloq orqasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'opposite' dan keyin 'to' KERAK EMAS.
'in front of' — uch so'z, hammasi kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is NEXT TO / OPPOSITE / BETWEEN ... the Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The museum is next to the hospital. The restaurant is opposite the post office.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muzey kasalxona yonida. Restoran pochta ro'parasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'cha ajratsa — opposite;  ajratmasa — next to.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is ON THE CORNER OF ... St AND ... St.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The garage is on the corner of Queen St and Victoria St.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Garaj Queen va Victoria ko'chalari burchagida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'zgarmas ibora: 'on the corner OF'.

sentencePatterns.formula: WAS/WERE + ega + ...?  →  No, ... wasn't/weren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Were you at the cinema last night? — No, I wasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun kinoteatrda midingiz? — Yo'q, emasdim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qisqa javobda savoldagi fe'l shakli takrorlanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There WAS/WEREN'T (ANY) + ot + joy + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There weren't any cars here forty years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qirq yil oldin bu yerda mashina yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tartib: There + fe'l + ot + JOY + VAQT.

sentencePatterns.formula: What were your favourite ...s when you were a child?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What were your favourite toys when you were a child?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bola bo'lganingda sevimli o'yinchoqlaring nima edi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikkala fe'l ham o'tgan zamonda.
'you' → DOIM were.

sentencePatterns.formula: DID + ega + HAVE + ot + when you WERE ... years old?  →  Yes, I DID. / No, I DIDN'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Did you have a dog when you were four years old? — Yes, I did.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: To'rt yoshingda iting bormidi? — Ha, bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: So'roqda HAVE, qisqa javobda DID — ikkisini aralashtirmang.

sentencePatterns.formula: X couldn't + fe'l + when she was ... , BUT she CAN + fe'l + NOW.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Laura couldn't play tennis when she was five years old, but she can play tennis now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Laura besh yoshida tennis o'ynay olmasdi, lekin hozir o'ynay oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'zgarish BOR → 'but ... can ... now'.

sentencePatterns.formula: X couldn't + fe'l + when she was ... AND she STILL CAN'T + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Laura couldn't cook when she was five years old and she still can't cook.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Laura besh yoshida ovqat pishira olmasdi va hali ham pishira olmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
O'zgarish YO'Q → 'and ... still can't'.
'but' emas, 'AND'.

sentencePatterns.formula: There WAS/WERE + ot + joy + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There wasn't a cinema here when I was a child. There weren't many shops here thirty years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men bola bo'lganimda bu yerda kinoteatr yo'q edi. O'ttiz yil oldin bu yerda ko'p do'kon yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ot BIRLIK → was/wasn't;  KO'PLIK → were/weren't.

sentencePatterns.formula: I AM ... years old (hozir)  ↔  I WAS ... years old (o'tgan).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I am twelve years old today. In 1980 I was ten years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun o'n ikki yoshdaman. 1980-yilda o'n yoshda edim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Yosh aytishda ingliz tilida 'to be' fe'li ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ilgari: ... WAS/WERE/HAD/COULD ... ,  hozir: ... IS/ARE/HAVE GOT/CAN ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I had a typewriter when I was fourteen, but I have got a computer now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'n to'rt yoshimda yozuv mashinkam bor edi, lekin hozir kompyuterim bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Butun 9-unit shu qarama-qarshilik ustiga qurilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + HAVE/HAS GOT + ot   ↔   Ega + CAN + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Now I have got a car and I can drive it very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hozir mashinam bor va uni juda yaxshi haydayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Keyin OT bo'lsa 'have got';  FE'L bo'lsa 'can'.

sentencePatterns.formula: There AREN'T ANY + ko'plik ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There aren't any parks now. I haven't got any cats.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hozir bog' yo'q. Mushugim yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'any' — inkor va so'roq gaplarda;  tasdiqda 'some'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + IS + A/AN + kasb.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My mother is a Maths teacher.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Onam matematika o'qituvchisi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kasb aytishda artikl SHART.
Undosh tovush → a;  unli tovush → an.

sentencePatterns.formula: CAN I help you, sir/madam?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I help you, sir?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yordam bera olamanmi, janob?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Do'kon, mehmonxona, idorada xodimning standart iborasi.

sentencePatterns.formula: a BOWL of soup  /  a CUP of tea  /  a GLASS of water
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I just want a bowl of soup for lunch.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tushlikka bir kosa sho'rva xohlayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Sanalmaydigan taom va ichimliklar idish nomi bilan sanaladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: You CAN + fe'l + AT THE + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can buy food at the supermarket. You can borrow books at the library.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Supermarketda oziq-ovqat sotib olsa bo'ladi. Kutubxonada kitob qarzga olsa bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'can' dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda.
Joy oldidan 'at the' — apostrofli do'konlarda ham.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is OPPOSITE / NEXT TO the Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The newsagent's is opposite the greengrocer's. The chemist's is next to the supermarket.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Gazeta do'koni meva do'koni ro'parasida. Dorixona supermarket yonida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'cha ajratsa — opposite;  ajratmasa — next to.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is BETWEEN the Y AND the Z.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The butcher's is between the restaurant and the baker's.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qassobxona restoran va nonvoyxona orasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'and' hech qachon tushmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is IN FRONT OF the Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The bus stop is in front of the post office.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avtobus bekati pochta oldida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Uch so'z — hammasi kerak.  Aksi: behind.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is ON THE CORNER OF ... Street AND ... Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The supermarket is on the corner of High Street and Park Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Supermarket High Street va Park Street burchagida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'zgarmas ibora: 'on the corner OF'.

sentencePatterns.formula: WAS/WERE + ism + ma'lumot?  →  No, ... wasn't/weren't.  ... was/were + boshqa ma'lumot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Was Marilyn Monroe a musician? — No, she wasn't. She was an actress.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Merilin Monro musiqachi midi? — Yo'q, emas edi. U aktrisa edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birinchi ma'lumot noto'g'ri, ikkinchisi to'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.formula: WERE there ANY + ko'plik?  →  No, there weren't, but there ARE some ... today.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Were there any department stores twenty years ago? — No, there weren't, but there are some great ones today.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yigirma yil oldin univermaglar bormidi? — Yo'q, lekin bugun ajoyiblari bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: INKORda 'any', TASDIQda 'some'.

sentencePatterns.formula: X couldn't + fe'l + when he was five, BUT he CAN + fe'l + NOW.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bob couldn't swim when he was five years old, but he can swim now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bob besh yoshida suza olmasdi, lekin hozir suza oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ✗ → ✓ o'zgarishi uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: X couldn't + fe'l + when he was five AND he STILL CAN'T + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bob couldn't ski when he was five years old and he still can't ski.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bob besh yoshida chang'i ucha olmasdi va hali ham ucha olmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ✗ → ✗ o'zgarishsiz holat uchun.  'but' emas, AND.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + IS/ARE + FROM + mamlakat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm from Spain. She is from Spain, too.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men Ispaniyadanman. U ham Ispaniyadan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kelib chiqish — DOIMIY fakt → hozirgi zamon.
'too' gap oxirida, oldidan vergul.

sentencePatterns.formula: X DIDN'T HAVE [bugungi narsa] ... years ago. She HAD [o'shandagi narsa].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Amy didn't have short hair fifteen years ago. She had long hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Emining o'n besh yil oldin kalta sochi yo'q edi. Uzun sochi bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Avval bugungi narsa inkor qilinadi, so'ng o'shandagisi tasdiqlanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: DID + ega + HAVE + ot + when she WAS ... years old?  →  No, she DIDN'T. She HAD ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Did Amy have short hair when she was ten years old? — No, she didn't. She had long hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Emi o'n yoshida kalta sochli midi? — Yo'q. Uzun sochi bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: So'roqda HAVE, qisqa javobda DIDN'T, tasdiqda HAD.

sentencePatterns.formula: Excuse me, is there a + joy + NEAR HERE?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Excuse me, is there a post office near here?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz, bu yaqinda pochta bormi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Notanish odamdan joy so'rashning eng oddiy shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: Go straight DOWN ... Street (and TAKE THE FIRST TURNING INTO ... Street). It's ON YOUR left/right.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Yes, go straight down King Street and take the first turning into Bridge Street. The newsagent's is on your right.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ha, King Street bo'ylab to'g'ri yuring va birinchi burilishdan Bridge Street ga kiring. Gazeta do'koni o'ng tomoningizda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Chap-o'ng YURISH YO'NALISHIGA bog'liq — xaritaga qarab aniqlang.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + IS + kasb.  +  He/She WORKS in ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My father is a doctor. He works in a hospital.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Otam shifokor. U kasalxonada ishlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikkala gap ham HOZIRGI zamonda bo'lishi kerak —
zamon mosligini keyingi gapdan tekshiring.

sentencePatterns.formula: A hundred years ago, life WAS very different for ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A hundred years ago, life was very different for the Inuit in Canada.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yuz yil oldin Kanadadagi inuitlar hayoti juda boshqacha edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'then and now' matnining tayyor KIRISH gapi.

sentencePatterns.formula: They HAD ... .  They DIDN'T HAVE ... .  They COULDN'T ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They had igloos. They didn't have houses to live in. They couldn't eat any fruit.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Iglulari bor edi. Yashash uchun uylari yo'q edi. Meva yeya olmasdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'TGAN qism uchun uchta asosiy qolip.

sentencePatterns.formula: Today, life ... ISN'T the same as it WAS ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Today, life for the Inuit isn't the same as it was a hundred years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun inuitlar hayoti yuz yil oldingidek emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
O'tgan qismdan hozirgi qismga O'TISH gapi.
Bitta gapda ikki zamon: ISN'T (hozir) ... WAS (o'shanda).
'the same AS' — 'as' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: They HAVE GOT ... .  There ARE ... .  They CAN ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have got modern houses. There are schools and hospitals. They can eat anything they like.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Zamonaviy uylari bor. Maktab va kasalxonalar bor. Xohlagan narsasini yeya oladilar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: HOZIRGI qism uchun uchta asosiy qolip.

sentencePatterns.formula: They HAVEN'T GOT ... ANYMORE.  They travel BY ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They haven't got sledges anymore. They travel by skidoo.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Endi ularda chana yo'q. Ular skidoo bilan yuradilar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'anymore' DOIM inkor bilan, gap oxirida.
Transport oldidan BY + artiklsiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: Their favourite free-time activities WERE/ARE + -ing shakllari.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Their favourite free-time activities were dancing and arts and crafts.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sevimli bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari raqs va hunarmandchilik edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'activities' KO'PLIK → were/are.
Mashg'ulotlar -ing shaklida.
